notes: SPT-3G 2019 search for axionlike time-dependent cosmic birefringence (AC oscillation effect) in CMB polarization. Sets 95% C.L. upper limits on g_phi_gamma over m_phi ~ 4.8e-22 to 9.6e-20 eV (oscillation periods 12 hours to 100 days). The limit scales linearly with mass; flat-region median limit is g < 1.18e-12 GeV^-1 x (m/1e-21 eV). Data points computed from the paper's explicit smoothed-limit formula Eq. (22) including the sinc correction at high mass. Assumes axions comprise all local dark matter with rho_0 = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (limit scales as (kappa*rho/0.3)^{-1/2}). Improves on BICEP/Keck AC-oscillation limits by factor ~3.8. Paper also shows projections for full SPT-3G survey and CMB-S4, but the primary result is a measured limit. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
